statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has episodes of dizziness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
The patient has unmeasured heart rate (R00.2)
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic concern for arrhythmia
The service is directly related to the diagnosed conditions
The service was rejected because it is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
